mapping.summary: Equipment rental management in BC: quotes, contracts, dispatch, returns, maintenance, billing.
claims: Billing cycles from daily to yearly, in advance or in arrears
Customer and group price lists with duration tiers, peak rates and minimum billing periods
Invoice suggestion worksheet previews all due orders with amount and tax
Combines orders on one invoice or previews pro forma
Credits unused advance-billed period on early return
Transfers units between depots and group companies across environments and tenants
Handles VAT, GST and sales tax with fixed contract exchange rates
Receiving a purchase order creates rental units with a fixed asset each
Mid-hire unit swaps keep billing continuous
Rental kits explode into machine, attachments and operator
Availability matrix and calendar across the fleet
Line-level allocation prevents double booking the same serial
Maintenance scheduled by calendar, meter reading or on return
Maintenance orders track labour, parts and contractor cost per unit with a Gantt view
Lapsed compliance certificates can block shipment
All modules free in sandboxes; Maintenance and Global Equipment licensed separately in production
